question: Should this current-main branch become the canonical ClinePass implementation instead of the conflicted original pull request?
rationale: Both open pull requests carry the same feature and original implementation authorship, but neither has sufficient live proof; choosing the landing branch and preserving attribution requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Use this branch after proof
options.body: Treat this clean current-main branch as canonical after the hash drift, lint failure, and live-proof gate are resolved, then close the older conflicted pull request with attribution preserved.

options.title: Return fixes to the original
options.body: Keep https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2199 canonical and move the rebase or conflict resolution there before reviewing the feature further.

recommendation.title: Use this branch after proof
recommendation.body: Treat this clean current-main branch as canonical after the hash drift, lint failure, and live-proof gate are resolved, then close the older conflicted pull request with attribution preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is best positioned to select the canonical contribution and confirm the desired provider-acceptance path.
